Verified against the installed binary (2.1.282) by grepping its Mach-O for the settings schema: effortLevel:G([\\u0022low\\u0022,\\u0022medium\\u0022,\\u0022high\\u0022,\\u0022xhigh\\u0022]).optional().catch(void 0), while the sibling maxEffortLevel key takes the five-name list including max, and the binary\\u0027s own help text says \\u0027max is session-only and is not written\\u0027. The .catch(void 0) means an out-of-enum value is swallowed silently: no warning, the key resolves to undefined, and the session runs at the model\\u0027s own default. Only the --effort CLI flag and CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL accept max.
